summary: The Tailwind theme emitter mapped every --ui-nav-* and --ui-border-* token into the colour namespace by prefix, minting utilities whose values are dimensions: --color-nav-width (17rem), --color-nav-rail-width, --color-edge-width. Nothing consumed them yet, but the first nav component would have reached for bg-nav-width and produced background-color: 17rem. The emitter now carries an explicit NOT_COLORS set for dimension/composite tokens whose names collide with colour families.

migration.manual: None — the removed colour utilities had no consumers.
